description: Zero-dependency "Ask AI about this page" button row that opens ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, Mistral or DeepSeek with a prefilled prompt. <ask-ai> web component, CDN script, React, Vue and Svelte.
rules: Read llms.txt for the import per framework: CDN script or ask-ai-widget/element for plain HTML, ask-ai-widget/react, ask-ai-widget/vue, ask-ai-widget/svelte.
Prompt options are strings or synchronous functions, never async.
The lite entries have no built-in services: pass objects imported from ask-ai-widget/services.
With SSR import ask-ai-widget/style.css once and pass page={{ url, title }}.
Style with --aai-* custom properties or the variant/size/shape/theme options; never copy the library CSS.
